title: query: report root commit and sync time in JSON
description: Core change (needs core lock). git vouch query should emit its registry root's HEAD commit and vouch-fetched time in its JSON, so git-vouch-trqp can copy them into ext and gate freshness on the same read that answered. Today the bridge re-derives the root (copying _registry_dir/_data_dir, ponytail in registry_root) and reads HEAD just before the query, so a sync between the two can make ext.commit one commit behind. From vouch-faq3.6 review.
